title: TikTok Shop Operator — Build & Run a US-Backed Affiliate Business (Base + Profit Share + Year-End Bonus)
description:
Compensation at a glance

$1,500/month base, paid weekly via Wise (guaranteed floor)

25% of monthly Net Profit you personally generate, paid monthly, uncapped

15% override on the net production of any helpers we hire under you

10% year-end bonus on your annual personal Net Profit, paid every January 31



Real comp examples: $2,750/mo at $5K NP · $5,250/mo at $15K NP · $9,000/mo at $30K NP (full math + worked example in the Compensation section below)



This pays 2–3x what every comparable TikTok Shop role on OnlineJobs.ph offers. Keep reading to see why we can pay this and what we expect in return.





Essentially: you are building an entire TikTok Shop affiliate company from the ground up, with full financial backing and US LLC infrastructure provided by us. You bring the operational skill. We bring the capital, legal structure, and US-side resources.





About this role: 

This is not a typical VA role. This is a lead operator role for someone who wants to build a real TikTok Shop affiliate business and earn like a senior tea
mber with real upside, not a flat-rate VA.



We're a US-based holding company launching a TikTok Shop affiliate operation. We provide the infrastructure — US LLC, EIN, US bank account, US-resident device/IP setup, US shipping addresses, working capital, and TikTok Shop seller verification. You build and run the operation. Product research, account warming, scripts, content production, posting, optimization, scaling. When the time is right, you propose new hires and we approve, fund, and onboard them under our LLC — and you earn a cut of what they produce.



You're the operator on the ground. The owner is hands-on with strategy, sets all base pay, approves all hires and fires, and owns final say on direction. You drive execution day-to-day with real autonomy inside that framework.



If you've ever run a successful TikTok Shop account and thought "I should be doing this with a real company behind me instead of $2/hr for an agency" — this is that opportunity, with the US LLC infrastructure already solved.



What success looks like

Month 1: Two TikTok Shop accounts warmed and posting 5+ videos/day each, with first commission revenue landed

Month 3: Three accounts running, 10+ videos/day total, $3,000+/month in net profit, your share clearing $750/month on top of base

Month 6: Established daily playbook, $15,000+/month in net profit, your share at $3,750/month on top of base (total ~$5,250/month)

Month 12: Scaled operation with 1–2 helpers you've trained, $25,000+/month net profit possible, your share clearing $6,000+/month plus base plus year-end bonus



Day-to-day responsibilities

You own day-to-day execution. That includes:



Product research — daily Kalodata / Shoplus / FastMoss workflow, your own filter stack, daily shortlist of 10 candidates, scoring top-performing videos for replicability



Sample sourcing — submit free sample requests and refundable sample purchases via TikTok Shop Creator Center to our US shipping addresses



Content production — generate 5 script variants per winning product, brief US-based on-camera recorders with structured shot lists, edit raw clips in CapCut



UGC creator hiring — you can brief and hire US-based on-camera talent through 
 (you brief them, they record, you edit and post — they don't need to keep the product). Budget for this comes out of operating expenses, approved by us.



Account operations — stagger-post 5–15 videos/day across 2–3 TikTok accounts (each on its own isolated device/IP), tag every video's affiliate product from Showcase before publishing, manage comment moderation and account hygiene



Pre-followed account acquisition — purchasing TikTok Shop-eligible accounts (5,000+ followers) is a legitimate part of the playbook. You'll source candidate accounts and submit them for our approval before purchase.



Drop-off & hook analytics — pull swipe-away / retention curves from TikTok analytics on every video, identify exactly where viewers leave, and use that data to rebuild hooks that hold attention past the first 3 seconds



Performance management — track 24-hour and 72-hour performance per video in shared Google Sheets, flag winners and losers per decision rules you build (with our sign-off)



Team training (when we hire) — when we approve a new hire, you train them, oversee their daily output, and earn a percentage of their net production on top of your base and your own profit share



Must-haves

1+ year hands-on TikTok Shop affiliate experience (you've personally operated accounts, not just managed someone else's)



Working knowledge of Kalodata, Shoplus, or FastMoss — you can name the filter stack you'd use to find a trending product without us prompting



Hook analytics fluency — you regularly look at where viewers swipe away from your videos and use that data to rebuild hooks. You can explain a specific time you fixed a low-retention video by studying the drop-off curve.



Exceptional written English (your scripts go to US viewers; your briefs go to US recorders)



Proven ability to ship volume — 5+ videos/day, every workday, without quality drop



Data-driven mindset — you read GMV growth, commission rate, and affiliate count signals fast and act on them



2+ years remote work experience with verifiable OnlineJobs.ph or Upwork references



Proficient in Slack, ClickUp or Notion, Google Sheets, CapCut, ChatGPT



4+ hour overlap with US Mountain Time



Reliable computer, fast internet, backup power



Comfortable with daily WhatsApp check-ins (morning plan + end-of-day recap) and a weekly direction call



Operator mindset — you treat this like real work that compounds, not a 9-to-5



Nice-to-haves

Prior experience under a US-LLC-backed structure operating US-market TikTok Shop accounts

Experience editing UGC-style product review videos

Experience hiring and briefing UGC creators (HourlyUGC, Upwork, Billo, etc.)

Experience buying and warming pre-followed TikTok accounts safely

Hands-on with Claude Code for scripting and automation tasks

Familiarity with US residential proxy / remote-desktop tooling (AnyDesk, RustDesk, BrightData)

Experience running multiple isolated social accounts without crossing fingerprints

Prior experience training and overseeing junior tea
mbers



Resources we provide

US LLC, EIN, US bank account, US shipping addresses, TikTok Shop seller verification

Working capital for samples, account purchases, and initial creator briefs

Tools budget: Kalodata, Shoplus or FastMoss, ChatGPT Plus, Claude Code, CapCut Pro, any other tool you make a case for

US-based UGC talent budget via HourlyUGC and similar platforms

Daily strategy access to the owner via WhatsApp, weekly direction call





Compensation

Base salary: $1,500/month ($8.66/hr × 40 hrs/week), paid weekly via Wise — your guaranteed floor



Personal profit share: 25% of monthly Net Profit you personally generate, paid monthly, uncapped, for as long as you are with the company



Net Profit definition: Gross affiliate commission revenue minus all operating costs, including your $1,500/month base salary, contractor pay (UGC creators, helpers), software subscriptions (Kalodata, CapCut, ChatGPT, Claude Code, etc.), sample purchases, account purchases, banking fees, and US LLC overhead. Your base is paid by the company as a normal expense — it does NOT come out of your 25% share.



Worked example (a $5,000 Net Profit month):



Gross affiliate commission revenue: $8,000

Less your base salary: ?$1,500

Less samples & account purchases: ?$500

Less software (Kalodata, CapCut, ChatGPT, Claude Code): ?$300

Less UGC creator contractor pay: ?$500

Less banking and LLC overhead: ?$200

= Net Profit: $5,000



Your 25% share: $1,250

Your total monthly comp: $1,500 base + $1,250 share = $2,750

Comp at higher Net Profit tiers (base always paid separately on top):

At $5,000/month Net Profit: $1,500 base + $1,250 share = $2,750/month total



At $15,000/month Net Profit: $1,500 base + $3,750 share = $5,250/month total



At $30,000/month Net Profit: $1,500 base + $7,500 share = $9,000/month total



Team override (when we hire helpers under you): When the company hires a helper under your direction, the helper's net production is split three ways:



Helper: 25% of their own net production (same share structure as yours)



You (operator override): 15% of the helper's net production, paid monthly alongside your personal profit share



Company: the remaining 60%



The 15% override equals 20% of the company's 75% cut — a meaningful piece of every helper you train and retain. The better you train them and the longer they stay productive, the larger your monthly override grows. Worked example: if a helper generates $5,000/month in net production, helper earns $1,250, you earn an additional $750 override on top of your own profit share, company keeps $3,000.



Year-end bonus: At fiscal year-end (December 31), you receive a bonus equal to 10% of the personal net profit you generated for the company during that fiscal year, paid by January 31.



Example: if your personal accounts generated $120,000 in net profit across the calendar year, your year-end bonus = $12,000, on top of all monthly profit shares already paid



This is designed to reward staying through the full year — someone who's accrued meaningful YTD profit has a real reason to finish the year strong rather than walk in November



Bonus applies only if you're with the company on December 31 of that year



Performance floor: After the first 3 months (during which we are getting the process / pipeline up and running): 

Your personal monthly net profit generation must clear your monthly base pay ($1,500). If you fall below base for 3 consecutive months OR any 4 months within a rolling 6-month window, the role is terminated unless we judge that exceptional extenuating circumstances apply (which we will weigh case by case).



Why this beats every comparable listing:

Typical TikTok Shop VA on OnlineJobs.ph: $800–1,500/month flat, no profit share, no bonus

Senior pod operator with commission: $1,500–2,000/month + 5% personal sales (~$1,750/month at our target revenue)

Most "profit share" listings: $2,000 base + 10?ove a high margin threshold (~$2,250/month at our target revenue)

This role at $15K/month personal net profit: $5,250/month + 15% override on any helpers you train (~$750/mo per $5K-producing helper) + year-end bonus accruing toward $12K+ — total annualized comp ceiling far above any flat-rate or pod role on this platform



Transparency: Net Profit is calculated from a Google Sheet you'll have read access to, updated daily. Every line item is visible. No black box.



How we work together

Daily WhatsApp check-ins. Each morning you send a short message with your plan for the day. Each evening you send a recap of what you completed. Takes 5 minutes total. This is non-negotiable.



Weekly direction call. One scheduled call per week (30–45 min) to discuss overall progress, priorities, and any decisions that need our sign-off.



Final decisions rest with us — all hiring, firing, base pay, account purchases, and revenue policy decisions default to the owner. You propose, recommend, build the case. We approve.



You have real autonomy inside that framework on day-to-day execution: content choices, hook iterations, posting cadence, niche pivots, product picks, contractor briefs.



Long-term mindset — the owner's other business has retained OnlineJobs.ph hires for 2+ years. We invest in operators who invest in us.



How to apply

Follow all application instructions below carefully.



In your application message, answer every question below, numbered, in order:



List every TikTok Shop affiliate account you've personally operated. Include handle and approximate monthly revenue at peak.



What product research tool do you use? Walk us through your exact filter stack — the specific filters, in order, that you'd apply right now to find a trending product worth promoting this week.



Describe one specific time you looked at a TikTok video's swipe-away curve, identified where viewers were dropping off, and rebuilt the hook to fix it. What did the original hook say, what did the data show, and what did you change it to?



Pick one TikTok Shop product you'd promote this week. Tell us (a) the product, (b) why you'd promote it (data-backed), and (c) the exact 3-second hook you'd open with.



Describe one independent operational decision you've made on a TikTok Shop account — what was the call, what was the data behind it, what was the outcome?



What's your current US Mountain Time overlap availability?



What tools are you currently paying for out of your own pocket?



Do you currently operate any personal TikTok Shop accounts? (Yes/No — full disclosure required if yes)





At the very end of your application, in the final line, type the word "Kalodata" so we know you read this entire post.



For applicants who do follow these instructions, we'll shortlist the strongest candidates for a paid 2-hour trial task ($16 paid via Wise), and then interview finalists directly with the owner.



We're hiring one person and we'd rather wait three weeks for the right one than three days for the wrong one.



If you've ever wanted to run a US-market TikTok Shop business with the LLC, banking, and infrastructure handled — this is your shot.

description:
Job Overview:

I run multiple businesses across automotive and home improvement, and I need a sharp, reliable WordPress + SEO specialist who can take ownership of three websites long-term. This is NOT a project hire — I'm looking for someone to grow into a permanent role for years.



You'd be working directly with me (the owner). No agency layers, no middlemen. If you do good work, this is a stable full-time position for as long as you want it.



What You'd Be Doing

Immediate priority (first 30–60 days):



Migrate one site from Elementor ? Beaver Builder (theme swap, full rebuild)

Build out 15–30 pages on a second site that's being trimmed down from 500 pages

Migrate a third site from Wix/Squarespace ? WordPress + Beaver Builder

Build out service pages for the third site once migrated



Ongoing (after initial migrations):



Local SEO across all three sites (on-page, off-page, technical)

Backlink building (white-hat, sustainable, niche-relevant)

New page builds as needed

Design refinement and brand consistency work

Site speed optimization

Schema markup, Google Business Profile management

Performance monitoring and reporting





Who I'm Looking For

Required skills (non-negotiable):



3+ years building production WordPress sites

Strong Beaver Builder + Themer experience (please don't apply if you've only used Elementor)

Proven local SEO experience — specifically Google Maps/Local Pack rankings, not just generic SEO

Backlink building experience with documented results

Ability to migrate between page builders (Elementor ? Beaver Builder) without breaking SEO

Migration experience from Wix/Squarespace ? WordPress

Clean, modern design sense — not template-y



Bonus points:



Experience with automotive industry sites

Experience with home improvement/contractor sites

Custom CSS skills for design tweaks

Schema markup expertise

Google Search Console + GA4 proficiency

Yoast or Rank Math SEO plugin mastery

Experience with multi-site portfolios



The Sites (Privacy First)

I'm intentionally not sharing the URLs in this public posting to protect my sites from spam and competitor snooping. Once we have a serious conversation, I'll share them with you.

What I can tell you:



Site 1: Auto detailing & ceramic coating business. Currently on Beaver Builder Pro with Themer. Needs ongoing page builds and a color theme swap (gold ? blue) across existing pages.

Site 2: Marble and granite countertop business. 500-page site needs to be cut down to 15–30 pages. Currently on a different platform, needs migration. Redirects from old pages to new home page acceptable.

Site 3: Auto customization shop. Currently on Wix/Squarespace, light content. Needs full migration to WordPress + Beaver Builder, plus service pages built out.



All three are real businesses with real customers, real revenue, and active marketing. This is meaningful work, not portfolio fillers.



Hours, Pay, and Benefits

Schedule:



40 hours/week, full-time

Working hours flexible within US business hours overlap (specific shift TBD with you)

Long-term position (years, not months) for the right person



Pay:



$6-13/hour USD depending on experience

Weekly pay via Wise or PayPal

Performance-based raises every 6 months

Bonus structure for major project completion milestones



Benefits:



13th-month pay

Paid PH national holidays

7 paid days off after 6 months

$200 equipment stipend after 6 months

Direct mentorship from a multi-business owner

Long-term stability — I'm hiring to keep, not to churn





How to Apply

Don't send a generic application. I'll ignore it. Here's what I need:

1. Subject line:



"WordPress + Beaver Builder + Local SEO — [Your Name]"



2. In your application, include:



3 examples of WordPress sites you've built or significantly redesigned in Beaver Builder (live URLs required — no screenshots from your portfolio site)

1 example of a successful local SEO project with before/after metrics (Google Maps rankings, organic traffic growth, or local pack visibility)

Your experience with each: Beaver Builder (years), Elementor (years), local SEO (years), backlink building (years)

A 60–90 second voice recording (Loom or audio file) introducing yourself and answering: "Walk me through how you'd approach migrating a 500-page WordPress site down to 30 pages without losing SEO ranking."



3. Answer these questions in writing:



What's the longest you've held a single client/job?

What's your monthly capacity right now — could you commit 40 hours/week starting?



4. Internet speed screenshot (speedtest.net)

I look forward to your applications!

title: Architect
description:
We are seeking a licensed Architect or highly experienced architectural professional with a strong background in working with a California-based clients to join our team. In this role, you will be responsible for producing precise elevations, coordinating MEP (mechanical, electrical, plumbing) layouts, and ensuring that all measurements are meticulously verified. This position requires a deep understanding of construction documentation, interior architecture, and the ability to bridge the gap between conceptual design and technical execution. You will work during PST business hours and get paid weekly + HMO.



To prioritize your application, please complete the assessment: 



Qualifications



- Bachelor’s degree in Architecture (or related field) with 2-3 years of professional experience.



- Proven experience working directly with US-based architecture firms, developers, or clients (knowledge of US building standards, imperial units, and architectural workflows is required).



- Strong creative vision balanced with technical precision.



- Demonstrated ability to manage complex project workflows with high attention to detail.



Responsibilities



- Utilize existing SketchUp models to develop detailed architectural plans, elevations, and construction details. Verify all measurements for electrical, plumbing, and structural elements to ensure accuracy.



- Collaborate with US-based clients, vendors, and internal tea
mbers to interpret project goals, address client needs, and ensure design intent is maintained through the construction documentation phase.



- Prepare high-quality client presentations, including 3D mock-ups and renderings, to communicate design concepts effectively.



- Assist in preparing project quotes, ensuring adherence to the full project workflow from schematic design through to construction administration.



- Maintain up-to-date knowledge of industry standards, building technologies, and architectural best practices to ensure all deliverables meet professional standards.



- Handle project documentation, record-keeping, and vendor management to ensure seamless project delivery.

But…

If you work at a job that fills you with dread the night before…

And if you want to wake up in the morning because you CAN’T WAIT to get to work to see your friends and to push yourself to be more successful, and even make a lot more money…



Then we want to talk to you.



We’re looking for tea
mbers who are starving to push themselves beyond their personal limits, to earn money and recognition they deserve, and to have an amazing life-long career in an environment where you work with friends every day.



What’s So Different Here?



Our target is simple: to become THE place that every hungry superstar WANTS to work where they can and will achieve “rock legend” status.



Here are just a few of the reasons that our tea
mbers love working here:



Make more money: we pay more than most

This is a long-term, year around position 

Paid training

Year around full time work

Pathways to advancement

Achievable Bonuses you can work towards to give yourself an immediate raise





We have built the strongest team and culture you’ve ever seen, where tea
mbers are deeply motivated; we care about you and your hobbies and your family and your free time and make sure that you can have the balance in your life to enjoy it all; we’re constantly expanding so we’ve created some amazing opportunities for you. We want to help you dream big in your life and career… and we want to help you achieve it all.



Who are we? We’re Stillwater Bath and Shower and Fort Collins Bath and Home Remodeling. Steve and Taylor started Stillwater 1 year ago – just two brother-in-laws wanting to make a difference in the bathroom remodel industry. Taylor has many years in the handyman and Bathroom Remodel fields in the Northern Colorado area. He is the Guru behind the service specific tasks and you could call him the Sales Super Hero. Steve owns and operates a window cleaning, gutter cleaning and pressure washing business in addition to this one. He understands the business stuff and helps with the “boring” stuff that keeps a business alive. Over the past year we built, expanded, and grew Stillwater. Today we are striving to be market leaders who DOMINATE the Colorado surrounding market with Solid Surface Shower Conversions and Bathroom Remodels. We’ve got 3 on staff and hope to have much more soon as we serve our customers in our area. And we help others too – we’re strong supporters of making a difference and creating positive and everlasting memories for customers who have their showers and bathrooms remodeled.



--- and it feels like we are only getting started. We recently moved into an office location, we’re adding more tea
mbers, and you should see the plan we have for growth beyond this. 



Are You a Fit?



Never look for a job again because we’re not a pit stop in your career – we’re the last place you’ll ever work! 



If you’re a hard-working professional with an inner drive to improve yourself and help others then you might be a fit for us…



Along with the job specific qualifications (below), here are the qualities we’re looking for in our perfect candidate:



You work hard

You love working with a team

You’re admin savvy – you can diagnose a problem and make recommendations to fix it

You love to serve others

You love to challenge yourself and you want to learn, and even be cross-trained

You understand the importance of serving others (your tea
mbers and our customers)

You understand and are willing to follow our core values.

Great Place To Work – We have each other’s backs. You look out for our customers and the company will look out for you. 



As an equal opportunity employer, candidates will receive consideration without discrimination against race, creed, color, sex, national origin, or veteran status.



“WE HIRE VETERANS!!!

Job Description

Today is awesome! You showed up for work, mingled with the team, and made note of the priorities to start your day. You’ve got the education to understand what’s to be done… now it’s time to roll up your sleeves and put it into action. s, writing up estimates, customer interaction, knowing that you’re adding a positive experience to our customers lives through the services we offer. title: Operations & Sales Manager
description:
Operations & Sales Manager — Aqua Home Supply

Remote | Philippines-Based | Full-Time Base: $1,500 USD/month + Uncapped Commission





About Aqua Home Supply

Aqua Home Supply is a fast-growing US-based e-commerce company specializing in water treatment products. We move fast, we take customer experience seriously, and we're looking for someone who takes ownership of their work and runs with it.





The Role

We're hiring an Operations & Sales Manager to own the day-to-day execution of our order fulfillment, vendor relationships, and customer operations. This is a critical role — you are the operational backbone of the business.



This is not a task-taker position. We need someone who identifies problems before they become fires, communicates proactively, follows through without reminders, and takes genuine pride in running a clean operation.



If that sounds like you, keep reading.





What You'll Own

Order Management & Fulfillment



Review the full order tracking queue daily — flag delays, contact vendors proactively, and ensure nothing falls through the cracks

Process approved orders accurately and on time

Manage open orders through to delivery confirmation (~150 orders/month)



Vendor Relations



All vendor communication runs through you — order status, delays, damage claims, cancellations, return authorizations, missing parts, and custom quotes

Build and maintain professional vendor relationships

Document every vendor interaction in the order record, same day



Customer Operations



Handle inbound sales inquiries under $4,000 — build quotes in Shopify and follow up via HubSpot

Manage escalated support tickets from our CS team via Zendesk

Respond to all direct customer
s within 24 hours

Ensure every customer is acknowledged before any ticket is escalated internally



Returns & Claims



Determine return eligibility, who covers shipping, and coordinate logistics

Request return authorizations from vendors and relay instructions to the CS team

Manage freight broker relationships for oversized returns

Track all open claims and follow up with vendors within 1–2 business days



Reporting & Admin



Prepare aged order summaries for weekly management review

Follow up on open HubSpot deals and unconverted quotes



Team Supervision



Daily check-in with our CS Reps — review the ticket backlog, flag stuck tickets, confirm nothing is sitting unaddressed

Give direct feedback to the CS Reps and escalate performance concerns when needed





What We're Looking For

Proven e-commerce or retail operations experience — you've managed orders, vendors, and customer issues before and you know what good looks like

Obsessive follow-through — things don't fall through the cracks on your watch

Detail orientation — you catch errors before they ship, not after

Proactive communication — you flag problems before deadlines, not after

Self-management — you don't need reminders to complete recurring tasks

Strong written English — you're communicating with US customers and vendors daily

Experience with Zendesk, Shopify, and/or HubSpot is a strong plus





What This Is Not

This role is not for someone who needs constant direction, waits to be asked before taking action, or lets aged issues sit without follow-up. We've built detailed SOPs and you'll have full support — but we need someone who executes independently and owns outcomes.





Compensation & Schedule

Base Salary: $1,500 USD/month

Commission: Earned on closed sales — uncapped. Top performers significantly exceed base pay.

Schedule: Full-time, aligned to US business hours

Location: Remote — Philippines-based candidates only





To Apply

Read these instructions carefully — they are part of the application process.



Subject Line: Your application must include the following subject line exactly as written: "AHS Ops — I Read Everything". Applications submitted without this exact subject line will be immediately discarded, no exceptions.



Your submission must include all three of the following:



Your CV/resume



A personalized video — record a short video (1-2 minutes) addressed specifically to Aqua Home Supply. Tell us who you are, what you know about our business, and why you believe you are the right fit for this role. Generic videos that could have been recorded for any company will not be considered. The video must mention Aqua Home Supply by name.



A written note — not a template, not a cover letter. A brief, specific paragraph telling us about an operational problem you personally identified and solved in a previous role. What was the problem, what did you do, and what was the outcome?



Applications missing any of these three elements will be discarded without review. We are looking for someone who follows instructions precisely and pays attention to detail — this process is the first test of exactly that.

Short-Term Rental Property Manager VA Job Post



Experienced Only — No Training Provided

?? Important: Do not apply if you have not personally used Hostaway, PriceLabs, Airbnb, or VRBO as a property manager or co-host. We will verify your experience with a skills test before any interview.



ABOUT THIS ROLE



We manage a growing portfolio of short-term rental properties and need a highly experienced VA who can hit the ground running with zero hand-holding. You will function as a full co-host and property manager — owning guest communication, listing management, pricing oversight, and operations from day one.



This is not a role where we will teach you the STR industry. If you do not already know the platforms, workflows, and guest experience standards at a professional level, please do not apply.



PLATFORMS YOU MUST KNOW BEFORE APPLYING



Hostaway

PriceLabs

Airbnb

VRBO

Truvi

Safely



DAY-TO-DAY RESPONSIBILITIES



Manage all guest communication in Hostaway — pre-booking, check-in, stay, checkout, and post-stay review requests — with professional, on-brand messaging

Monitor and respond to Airbnb & VRBO inquiries within SLA targets; handle objections and special requests confidently

Oversee PriceLabs settings, review pricing recommendations, flag anomalies, and make or escalate rate adjustments

Manage owner/guest insurance and damage claims through Safely and/or Truvi

Coordinate housekeeping, maintenance, and restock jobs through Hostaway task workflows

Keep listings optimized — photos, descriptions, amenities, house rules — across all OTAs

Flag negative reviews proactively and draft management responses

Manage owner reporting and reservation summaries as needed

Identify operational issues before they become guest complaints



REQUIRED SKILLS & EXPERIENCE



Minimum 2 years of hands-on experience as a STR property manager, co-host, or STR VA

Must have directly managed Hostaway (inbox, calendar, automations, task assignments)

Must have used PriceLabs — not just heard of it, but actively managed dynamic pricing settings

Strong written English — guest messages must be warm, clear, and professional without editing

Available during US business hours (Central or Eastern preferred); availability for weekend monitoring required

Reliable internet (minimum 20 Mbps), backup connection preferred

Highly organized and detail-oriented — you will manage multiple properties simultaneously

Proactive communicator — you escalate issues before they become problems



APPLICATION SCREENING QUESTIONS



Answer all of the following in your application. Vague or generic answers will be disqualified.



1. How many months or years have you actively managed properties in Hostaway? Describe 2 specific tasks you perform in it regularly.



Why we ask: Rules out anyone who has only watched tutorials or used it briefly.



2. In PriceLabs, what is a Base Price Multiplier and when would you adjust it? What is a Min Stay override and why would you use one?



Why we ask: Anyone who truly uses PriceLabs can answer this immediately.



3. A guest messages at 10pm saying the WiFi is down and threatens a 1-star review. Write exactly how you would respond and what steps you would take.



Why we ask: Tests real guest communication skill and problem-solving under pressure.



4. Describe a specific mistake you made managing a STR property and how you handled it.



Why we ask: Anyone with real experience has made and learned from mistakes. Vague answers are a red flag.



5. What is your current availability in US Central or Eastern time? Are you available for weekend monitoring?



Why we ask: Non-negotiable operational requirement.



6. What is your internet speed and do you have a backup connection? (Paste a screenshot of a speed test if possible.)



Why we ask: Connectivity issues are a disqualifier for remote guest communication roles.



COMPENSATION & DETAILS



Full-time, long-term position — we are not looking for freelancers or part-time applicants

Competitive salary based on verified experience level

Performance bonus structure available after 90-day probationary period

Stable, growing company — we want someone who will grow with us



HOW TO APPLY



Send your resume and answer all 6 screening questions above in your application message. Applications missing answers to any screening question will not be reviewed. Shortlisted candidates will receive a short practical skills test before any interview takes place.

Senior DTC Meta Media Buyer – Aviora

Aviora is building one of the fastest-growing supplement brands in the DTC space — and paid social is the engine behind it. We're now looking for an elite Meta media buyer to join our in-house team and own the performance of our paid campaigns from day one.

We don't guess. We test, we read data, and we scale what works. If you're the kind of operator who treats every dollar of ad spend as a decision — and can back every decision with numbers — we want to talk.



YOUR MISSION

Your mission is to profitably scale Aviora's customer acquisition through Meta paid social. You will own the full ad account — from campaign architecture and creative testing to budget management and performance reporting — ensuring we are consistently acquiring customers at or below target CAC while scaling spend efficiently.



RESPONSIBILITIES



Own and manage Aviora's Meta ad account end-to-end across
 and Instagram

Stay ahead of platform changes, algorithm shifts, and new Meta ad features — and apply them before competitors do

Ad Platform: Meta Ads Manager

Creative Management: Notion

Communication & Project Management: Slack & 





KPIs YOU WILL OWN



CAC: Customer acquisition cost at or below target threshold

ROAS: Campaign and account-level return on ad spend targets met consistently

Creative Velocity: New creative tests launched weekly — you move fast and keep the testing pipeline full

Spend Efficiency: Budget allocated and scaled in line with performance, no wasted spend sitting in underperforming ad sets





WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR



Proven experience running and scaling Meta ad accounts for DTC or eCommerce brands — supplement or health/wellness experience is a strong plus

Demonstrated ability to scale budgets profitably — we want to see numbers, not just titles

Deep understanding of Meta campaign structure, bidding strategies, audience segmentation, and creative testing methodology

Strong analytical instinct — you read data daily and make decisions from it, not gut feel

Experience briefing and collaborating with creative teams to produce performance-driven ad assets

An autonomous operator who owns outcomes, communicates proactively, and doesn't need hand-holding

Up to date on iOS privacy changes, Meta's evolving algorithm, and how to navigate attribution in a post-cookie environment





WHY JOIN AVIORA



Performance-Based Rewards: Bonus structure tied directly to account performance — when the numbers hit, you share in the upside

High Impact: You will have direct influence over the growth trajectory of a fast-scaling brand with a proven product

Work with the Best: Join a team of A-players across creative, video, and strategy who are all rowing in the same direction

High Autonomy: You own the account. We give you the budget, the creative team, and the trust — then we get out of your way

Growth Trajectory: For high performers, there are clear opportunities to step into a Head of Paid or Growth Lead role as the brand scales

Results-Driven Flexibility: We measure output, not hours. Be reachable during core hours (9AM–8PM ET), attend the Monday 12PM ET weekly call, and deliver results

Fully Remote: Work from anywhere in the world





THIS ROLE IS NOT FOR YOU IF

You prefer to set campaigns and check in weekly. This account needs daily attention, fast iteration, and sharp decision-making. If you're a passive manager, this isn't the right fit.

You struggle when platform rules change overnight. Meta's ad ecosystem shifts constantly — policy updates, algorithm changes, creative fatigue — and you need to adapt without losing 
ntum.

You see media buying as purely a numbers game with no creative involvement. At Aviora, the media buyer and creative team work closely together. You'll need to have strong opinions on what makes an ad perform, not just what makes it spend.

You want a stable, predictable workflow. We are scaling aggressively. Budgets move, priorities shift, and new opportunities need to be acted on fast. If that's stressful rather than energising, this isn't the right environment.



HOW TO APPLY

If you're an elite Meta media buyer who wants to own a high-growth ad account, work directly with founders, and be rewarded when the performance is there — we want to hear from you.

title: Video Editor
description:
# Hiring: YouTube Walking Tour Video Editor (4K Travel & Ambient Content)



## About the Channel



I am launching a premium YouTube channel called **Scape Walk 4K**, focused on immersive 4K walking tours from around the world.



The channel features:



* Cinematic walking tours

* Travel and city exploration

* Ambient natural sound

* No talking or vlogging

* Relaxing, immersive experiences

* 4K UHD content



Editing style should be similar to:



* POPtravel

* Nomadic Ambience

* Watched Walker

* 4K Urban Life



Reference Video:





---



# What You'll Be Editing



Raw footage filmed on:



* GoPro 4K

* City walks

* Parks

* Beaches

* Tourist attractions

* Nightlife districts

* Hidden local neighborhoods



Typical video length:



* 30–90 minutes



---



# Responsibilities



## Video Editing



* Remove unusable footage

* Remove unnecessary stops and interruptions

* Improve pacing while maintaining immersion

* Maintain a natural walking experience

* Deliver smooth, professional edits



## Color Grading



* Create a cinematic travel look

* Improve dynamic range

* Enhance colors naturally

* Improve nighttime footage

* Maintain realistic color representation



## Audio Enhancement



* Clean ambient audio

* Reduce wind noise

* Preserve natural environmental sounds

* Create immersive listening experiences



## YouTube Optimization



* Build strong opening sequences

* Improve audience retention

* Optimize export settings for YouTube 4K



## Thumbnail Creation (Bonus)



* Create compelling travel thumbnails

* Understand YouTube CTR principles

* Select strong 
nts from footage



---



# Required Skills



You should have experience editing:



* Walking tours

* Travel videos

* Ambient content

* Nature videos

* Cinematic city footage



Software:



* Adobe Premiere Pro

* DaVinci Resolve

* Final Cut Pro



Must understand:



* 4K workflows

* Audio cleanup

* Color grading

* Viewer retention

* Travel YouTube content



---



# What Makes an Ideal Candidate



The ideal editor understands that successful walking tour videos are not simply stitched-together footage.



The goal is to make viewers feel like they are physically present in the location.



You understand:



* Atmosphere

* Immersion

* Pacing

* Sound design

* Visual storytelling without narration



You know how to create content that keeps viewers watching for 15, 20, or even 30+ minutes.



---



# Application Requirements



Please include:



1. Your portfolio

2. Links to travel or walking tour videos you edited

3. Your editing software

4. Your rate per video

5. Typical turnaround time









---



# Paid Test Project



Shortlisted candidates will be given a paid test project.



You will receive approximately 5–10 minutes of raw footage and be asked to create a polished final edit.



The purpose is to evaluate:



* Editing judgment

* Audio quality

* Color grading

* Pacing

* Attention to detail



The test is paid.



---



# How Applications Will Be Evaluated



Candidates will be scored on:



### 30% – Travel / Walking Tour Experience



Show examples of similar work.



### 25% – Audio Quality



Ability to create immersive environmental sound.



### 20% – Color Grading



Ability to produce a cinematic but realistic image.



### 15% – Viewer Retention Understanding



Ability to identify and remove boring sections while preserving immersion.



### 10% – Communication & Reliability



Responsiveness, professionalism, and ability to meet deadlines.



---



# Long-Term Opportunity



This is not a one-time project.



The goal is to build a long-term relationship with an editor who can help grow Scape Walk 4K into a leading travel and walking-tour brand.



Expected production:



* 2–4 videos per week

* Consistent ongoing work

* Opportunity for increased responsibilities as the channel grows



---



# Important



Many editors can cut footage.



Very few editors understand how to create an immersive experience that makes viewers feel like they are walking through the city themselves.



If you have that skill, I would love to work with you.

title: Ecom Video Editor For Meta/TikTok Ads
description:

The Role:

You will work in lockstep with our Creative Strategist, taking raw footage (UGC, potentially studio shots) and briefs to produce engaging, platform-optimized video ads primarily for Meta (Facebook/Instagram) and TikTok. Your job is to execute rapidly, iterate effectively based on performance insights (provided by the strategist), and ensure the final output is engineered for maximum engagement and conversions. Forget long-form content; this is about short, punchy, direct-response video.

• Edit High-Performing Video Ads: Transform raw footage and strategist briefs into compelling video ads optimized for Meta and TikTok feeds/stories/reels.



• Rapid Iteration: Quickly execute multiple variations of winning ad concepts provided by the Creative Strategist (testing different hooks, visuals, text overlays, CTAs, music). Understand that iteration based on data is key.



• Platform Optimization: Expertly edit for platform best practices – strong hooks within the first 3 seconds, fast pacing, engaging captions/text overlays, appropriate aspect ratios (9:16, 1:1, 4:5), safe zones, and effective sound design.



• Integrate Copy & CTAs: Seamlessly weave in primary text concepts, headlines, and clear calls-to-action as guided by the strategist.



• Collaborate Closely: Maintain clear, fast communication (Slack, etc.) with the Creative Strategist to receive feedback, discuss edits, and ensure alignment with performance goals.



• Asset Management: Organize and manage video files and project assets efficiently.



• Meet Deadlines: Deliver high-quality edits reliably and on schedule in a fast-paced environment.



Who We're Looking For:



• Proven Social Ad Editing Experience: Minimum 2+ experience specifically editing short-form video advertisements for performance marketing campaigns on Meta & TikTok. A portfolio showcasing direct-response style video ads is required.



• Technical Proficiency: Highly skilled in video editing software (e.g., Adobe Premiere Pro, Final Cut Pro, CapCut is a major plus). Proficiency in basic motion graphics (e.g., After Effects for text overlays) is desirable.



• Platform Native: Deep understanding of what works visually on TikTok and Meta feeds/stories/reels – you know the trends, the hooks, the pacing, the sounds that grab attention immediately.



• Performance-Oriented Mindset: You understand the goal is conversion, not just aesthetics. You are receptive to feedback driven by ad metrics and can adapt edits accordingly. (Links to Strategist's "Data Mastery," "Creativity That Converts").



• Speed and Agility: Ability to work quickly, execute variations efficiently, and adapt to changing requirements without sacrificing quality. (Links to Strategist's "Adaptability & Agility").



• Collaborative Spirit: Excellent communication skills and ability to work effectively and receive direction from a Creative Strategist. (Links to Strategist's "Collaboration is Key," "Clear Communication").



• Strong Work Ethic & Accountability: Reliable, proactive, meets deadlines, and takes ownership of edit quality – no babysitting needed. (Links to Strategist's "Work Ethic").



• Detail-Oriented: Ensures brand consistency, correct aspect ratios, and error-free text/graphics. Nothing sloppy makes the cut.



• Basic understanding of direct response marketing principles.



• Experience editing UGC content.



Compensation:

$1,000 base monthly salary, plus monthly performance-based bonus/incentives tied to creative contribution.



How to Apply:



In your proposal, please include:



1. Provide your Resume/CV and link to your portfolio showcasing performance-driven social video ads for Meta/TikTok.

2. Briefly describe your process for editing a typical 15-45 sec. video ad.

3. How do you handle feedback and rapid iteration requests from creative strategists?

4. List your primary editing software and mention your experience with CapCut.

5. What AI tools or software have you used to create video ads? Provide as much detail as possible and share any previous AI work if any.

title: Social Media VA — Mining/FIFO UGC Sourcing & Creator Outreach
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

We're a Perth-based recruitment company in the Australian mining industry. We grow our brand by resharing the best viral and trending content about mining life, FIFO (fly-in fly-out) and DIDO (drive-in drive-out) work — always with the creator's permission and full credit — and using it to attract people who want to get into the industry.



We're looking for a sharp, online-savvy Social Media VA to keep a steady pipeline of this content flowing. You'll work during Australian Western Standard Time (AWST) business hours — the same as Philippine Standard Time.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Monitor TikTok, Instagram, YouTube,
, LinkedIn and Reddit for trending/viral content about the Australian mining industry and FIFO/DIDO life and roles

- Spot high-engagement posts early and track what's gaining traction

- Reach out to the original creator to request permission to (a) repost their content and (b) add our caption/call-to-action — professionally and on-brand

- ALWAYS credit and tag the original creator's handle on every repost, every time

- Repurpose approved content for our channels and add a clear call-to-action, e.g. "Interested in mining work or breaking into the industry? Reach out or visit our website."

- Keep written records of who was contacted, their response, and permission granted (in writing)

- Organize approved content into a library/spreadsheet with post links, creator handles, permission status, and usage notes



MUST-HAVE SKILLS

- Strong instinct for what's trending and shareable on social media

- Excellent written English with a friendly, persuasive outreach style

- Experience with creator / influencer / community outreach

- Highly organized — tracks every contact, credit, and permission carefully

- Comfortable across all major social platforms and basic content tools



NICE TO HAVE

- Experience running UGC, influencer, or repost-style campaigns

- Basic graphic/video editing to add captions and CTAs (Canva, CapCut)

- Any familiarity with mining, trades, FIFO work, or recruitment

- Social scheduling tools (Later, Buffer, Metricool)



HOW TO APPLY

I read every application, so please follow these steps:

1. Start your message with the word "REPOST-READY" (applications without it are deleted).

2. Send me a link to ONE trending post about Australian mining or FIFO life you can find, PLUS the short message you'd actually send that creator to ask permission to repost it with our caption added.

3. Tell me which platforms you know best and any UGC or creator-outreach work you've done.



Strong applicants will hear back within a few days. Looking forward to seeing what you find!

title: Head of Contact Center Operations - Remote
description:
Company Overview



The Compliance Services Organization didn't exist. We built it.



MP1 Solutions pioneered the Compliance Services Organization (CSO) — a new category of operating partner built to replace the fragmented vendor model that has defined compliance programs for decades. Built on the foundation of MedPro Disposal, the nation's largest privately-held medical waste company serving 35,000+ providers across 48 states over the past 15 years, MP1 Solutions extends that operational infrastructure, vendor network, and customer trust into a category we're actively building — and leading. We're doing it with a technology-forward approach, actively developing the AI infrastructure that will make this model smarter, faster, and more scalable as we grow.



What we do: We operate as the single compliance partner for non-acute healthcare facilities — consolidating every obligation into one coordinated program, assigning one dedicated account manager as the point of accountability, and actively managing the underlying vendor ecosystem through continuous evaluation, negotiation, and optimization on the practice's behalf.



Why it matters: Regulated facilities across the country are managing compliance the same fragmented way they always have. We're changing that — and we're looking for people who want to help build what comes next.



Our technology: We're actively building the AI infrastructure that sits behind this model — automating compliance tracking, surfacing risks before they become problems, and creating a system that gets smarter with every client we add. If you want to build at the intersection of compliance and technology, you're in the right place.



Our impact: Our clients never have to worry about something falling through the cracks — obligations are coordinated, tracked, and documented in one place. We audit costs, eliminate overcharges, and deliver proof of compliance that always keeps practices inspection ready. Every client has one dedicated account manager who owns their program end to end. And unlike a traditional vendor relationship, our model is designed to get better over time — continuously re-evaluated, optimized, and improved with every client we serve.



Position Overview:

The Head of Contact Center Operations is the senior execution leader of MedPro and MP1's contact center — the person who makes the operation run, improves it continuously, and manages the managers who manage the floor. You report to the VP of Operations and translate their strategic direction into daily operational reality.



This role sits at the intersection of operator and thought partner. You have done this before: run high-volume, multi-channel service environments, built capacity plans between labor and systems, designed operating models from the ground up, and led teams through system migrations without losing service continuity. You are not here to hold the org steady — you are here to elevate it.



Where the VP of Operations sets the vision, you own delivery. When the VP of Operations needs to present performance to the COO, the data, the narrative, and the operational confidence behind it come from you. When the organization needs its service processes redesigned, its CRM environment assessed, or its team structure rebuilt — that work belongs to you.



Key Responsibilities:

Multi-Layer Team Leadership & People Development

• Lead, coach, and develop Operations Managers and Team Leads — you manage the managers, and they manage the floor. Build leaders who build others.

• Establish clear performance expectations, coaching cadences, and accountability frameworks across all leadership levels — weekly 1:1s, call calibrations, structured performance reviews, and real-time feedback loops.

• Drive workforce planning and capacity modeling: design the right staffing structure between labor, channels, and volume patterns — not just fill headcount, but engineer capacity.

• Build succession plans and internal development pathways that reduce external hiring dependency and create a promotion pipeline from within.

• Own recruitment strategy for the operations team in partnership with HR — attract, hire, and retain the caliber of leader and frontline talent that the CSO model demands.

• Foster a performance culture aligned to MedPro's values: Do the Right Thing, Figure It Out, Win as a Team, and Accountability & Ownership.



Operating Model Design & Service Delivery

• Assess the current state of the contact center operation — people, process, structure, channels, and systems — and translate findings into a clear-eyed redesign plan with sequenced priorities.

• Design and implement the operating model: how the team is structured, how work flows through channels, how performance is governed, and how the organization scales as the client base grows.

• Own day-to-day operational performance across all service channels — inbound and outbound voice,
, chat, and SMS — with direct accountability for SLA attainment, handle time, first-contact resolution, and quality scores.

• Build and maintain the full SOP and playbook library: every process documented, auditable, and owned. If it is not written down, it does not exist.

• Own the quality assurance framework — define rubrics, conduct or oversee audits, deliver structured coaching feedback to leads, and use quality data to drive continuous improvement.

• Manage real-time workload distribution across channels — monitor queues, adjust staffing deployment as volume shifts, and act on performance signals without waiting to be asked.



System Assessment & Service Technology Migration

• Conduct a thorough assessment of the current CRM and service technology environment — understanding what exists, what is working, what is limiting, and what migration path forward best serves the operation.

• Lead the end-to-end service system migration: requirements gathering, vendor evaluation, workflow configuration, data mapping, agent training, parallel testing, and go-live — while maintaining service continuity throughout.

• Design and configure case management workflows, escalation paths, SLA tracking, and omni-channel routing logic in the new system, aligned to MedPro's service model and client base.

• Partner with the internal technology team to ensure all system integrations — IVR handoffs, client account data, ticketing — flow cleanly from day one.

• Build post-migration operating model documentation: how cases are created, routed, resolved, escalated, and reported — so no process lives in someone's head.

• Drive full agent and Team Lead adoption: training materials, live coaching sessions, compliance monitoring, and performance metrics in the new system until it is the single active system of record.

• Design, build, and maintain IVR call flows that intelligently route clients, reduce handle time, and improve containment — build these, not just manage ones that already exist.



Performance Management, Data & Reporting

• Own the KPI framework — define the right metrics, build the dashboards, and drive accountability systems that make performance visible and improvable at every level of the team.

• Deliver structured weekly and monthly performance reports to the VP of Operations — covering channel SLA attainment, CSAT trends, quality scores, case volume, and system migration status.

• Translate floor-level data into operational decisions and clear narrative: what is driving variance, what specific action will improve it, and what the risk is if it is not addressed.

• Communicate proactively to the VP of Operations about service risks, capacity issues, and migration blockers — full transparency, solution-first framing, no surprises that should have been visible earlier.

• Identify and scope AI-assist and automation opportunities (IVR containment, agent-assist prompts, chatbot deflection) — bring the VP of Operations a prioritized business case, not just ideas.



Client Experience & Regulatory Compliance

• Own the client experience at the operational level — serving as the escalation point for complex service issues and ensuring every client interaction reflects MedPro and MP1's positioning as a true compliance partner.

• Map and continuously improve the client journey across all contact touchpoints — identifying friction, closing gaps, and driving measurable improvements in client satisfaction scores.

• Ensure operational adherence to all applicable data security, privacy, and healthcare regulatory requirements including HIPAA and related standards.

• Partner with Sales and Client Success to align operational delivery with client growth, renewal, and expansion strategies.



Qualifications:

Required

• 10–15 years of total experience in contact center operations, service delivery, or BPO leadership — with significant, demonstrable accountability for team performance, service transformation, and operational change.

• Minimum 5 years in a senior people-management role with direct accountability for multi-layer teams (managers managing managers), department-level KPIs, and operational planning. Candidates who have only managed frontline teams — and not managed managers — will not be a fit.

• Proven experience operating in high-volume, multi-channel service environments with large numbers of customer interactions across voice,
, chat, and digital touchpoints. This is an execution role — we need someone who has run the floor at volume, not just designed programs from above it.

• Demonstrated experience leading a service system migration in a live contact center — transitioning a team from a legacy CRM to a modern platform while maintaining service continuity. Salesforce Service Cloud experience is strongly preferred.

• Hands-on capacity planning expertise: ability to model the right labor structure against channel mix, volume forecasts, and SLA requirements — and build the operating model that delivers it.

• Deep IVR design and multi-channel routing experience — you have built IVR flows from scratch, configured routing logic, and measured containment impact.

• Strong analytical capability — builds and interprets dashboards, identifies performance drivers, and communicates findings clearly to senior leadership.

• Exceptional written and verbal English communication skills for daily interaction with U.S.-based leadership.

• Background in healthcare BPO, compliance services, regulated service industries, or U.S.-facing contact center operations strongly preferred.



Nice-to-Have

• Salesforce Service Cloud proficiency — case management, workflow rules, SLA configuration, omni-channel routing, and reporting.

• Experience with AI-assist tools in contact center settings: agent-assist prompts, chatbot deflection, predictive routing.

• Workforce management platform experience (NICE IEX, Verint, Calabrio, or similar).

• HIPAA familiarity and/or exposure to U.S. healthcare regulatory compliance operations.

• Track record of building or rebuilding operations within a high-growth or category-defining company.

• Six Sigma, COPC, or equivalent contact center quality certification.



Compensation & Benefits:

• Salary Range: $18-$24/hr 

• Permanent work-from-home

• 40 hours per week, aligned with U.S. business hours (CST, graveyard shift).

• Fixed weekends off (Saturday & Sunday)

• Work Anniversary Bonus

• No work with pay on US Holidays

• Paid Leaves after 6 months of employment!



Basic Technical Requirements:

• Your own laptop/desktop PC with the following minimum specs: i5 5th gen and above/AMD equivalent; 8GB RAM; Mozilla or Chrome installed; Windows 10 upwards.

• A consistent and stable internet connection of at least 20Mbps

• With back-up computer, internet connection and power supply

• Noise-canceling headset/headphones

• A quiet and dedicated workspace at home



Application Process:

1. Your most updated resume.



2. Submit to all of these
s:

MedPro Disposal and MP1 Solutions are equal opportunity employers. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

title: Amazon OA Sourcing VA | 3P Mercury Experience a Plus
description:
Looking for an Amazon Online Arbitrage specialist focused on sourcing & database building. This is a singular-focus role: find great ASINs and build our Lead Vault. No POs, no operations, no logistics. Just sourcing.



We use 3P Mercury as our sourcing tool. If you have solid OA/Amazon sourcing experience, we'll train you on the tool. If you already know 3P Mercury, even better.



About Us

We run a growing Amazon Online Arbitrage business. This role handles sourcing and Lead Vault building exclusively. Your job is to find and add quality ASINs to the database. That's it.



What You'd Be Doing

Finding ASINs using manual sourcing techniques, reverse sourcing tools, and market research

Evaluating ASINs by checking sales velocity, profitability potential, competitive dynamics, and sourcing feasibility

Building & maintaining our Lead Vault by importing qualified ASINs into 3P Mercury with proper sourcing data

Validating sources by confirming product match, pack sizes, supplier legitimacy, and ongoing availability

Reporting on weekly/monthly database growth and sharing insights on trends

What We're Looking For

Must-Have:



? Hands-on experience with Amazon OA: you know sourcing, profitability math, and FBA dynamics

? Proven sourcing track record: you've found and sourced ASINs (any method is fine)

? Keepa proficiency: you can read charts, use Product Finder, and pull seller data

? Attention to detail: validating sources, confirming product match, pack sizes, supplier legitimacy. If you've read this far, make sure your application header starts with 3PM so we know you're paying attention.

? Fast, reliable internet and a quiet workspace

? Coachability: willing to learn our sourcing system and philosophy

Nice-to-Have:



? Experience with 3P Mercury (we have a complete training guide if you're new)

? Experience with ArbiSource (you'll have access and will be expected to use it)

? Familiarity with other reverse sourcing tools (Nepeto, Tactical Arbitrage)

? Experience with cashback stacking (BeFrugal, Rakuten, TopCashback)

? Knowledge of discounted gift card sourcing

Screening Questions

Please answer these in your application. We're assessing both your OA sourcing experience and your understanding of our approach.



1) Walk us through your sourcing process. What tools do you use? How many ASINs can you typically find and validate in a week? What criteria do you evaluate before d
 to source an ASIN?



2) Explain what you look for when evaluating an ASIN for profitability. What metrics matter most to you? Why?



3) What is the key difference between traditional OA sourcing and the 3P Mercury sourcing method? If you've used 3PM, explain how the approach works differently and why that matters. If you've never used 3PM, just write: never used 3PM.



4) What's your biggest challenge with sourcing? Where do you get stuck or lose time?



5) Why are you interested in this role? What appeals to you about focusing exclusively on sourcing and database building?



Note: We're looking for practical sourcing knowledge and someone who can explain their process clearly. Generic answers won't work.



Position Details

Type: Part-Time (flexible hours)

Schedule: Approximately 15-20 hours/week (negotiable based on performance)

Rate: Competitive, based on experience. Please include your desired hourly rate.

title: Global Sourcing & Supplier Development Manager
description:
Position Summary



We are seeking a highly skilled Global Sourcing & Supplier Development Manager to lead the identification, qualification, negotiation, and ongoing management of manufacturing partners throughout Asia and the Americas. This individual will play a critical role in securing competitive pricing, ensuring regulatory compliance, maintaining quality standards, coordinating packaging development, and supporting production execution.



The ideal candidate possesses strong international sourcing experience, exceptional negotiation skills, excellent English communication abilities, and an unwavering commitment to ethical business practices. This position works closely with the Director of Supply Chain Operations, who is responsible for forecasting and demand planning, to ensure products are delivered on time, within budget, and in compliance with all applicable regulations.



This is a strategic role responsible for protecting company interests, reducing risk, improving supplier performance, and maximizing value across the global supply chain.



Key Responsibilities

Strategic Sourcing & Supplier Development

Identify, evaluate, and onboard manufacturers and suppliers globally.

Source products from factories throughout:

China

Vietnam

Thailand

Malaysia

Indonesia

Cambodia

Mexico

Central America

South America

Other emerging manufacturing regions

Conduct supplier capability assessments.

Develop and maintain a qualified supplier network.

Continuously identify alternative suppliers to reduce supply chain risk.

Benchmark market pricing and manufacturing costs.

Analyze global manufacturing trends, tariffs, freight costs, labor markets, and geopolitical risks.

Supplier Negotiations

Lead all commercial negotiations with factories and suppliers.

Obtain the most competitive pricing, payment terms, tooling arrangements, and production commitments.

Negotiate annual cost reductions where appropriate.

Develop leverage strategies among multiple suppliers.

Present sourcing recommendations supported by objective financial analysis.

Maintain detailed records of negotiations and supplier communications.

Quality & Supplier Performance

Coordinate supplier qualification and approval processes.

Monitor supplier quality metrics and corrective actions.

Work with factories to resolve quality issues.

Coordinate inspections and quality audits.

Ensure suppliers maintain required certifications and quality systems.

Track supplier performance including:

Quality

Delivery

Responsiveness

Cost competitiveness

Regulatory compliance

Regulatory & Compliance Management

Coordinate regulatory documentation and compliance requirements.

Maintain supplier records and certifications.

Support product registrations and regulatory submissions where applicable.

Ensure supplier adherence to:

FDA requirements

ISO standards

Product testing requirements

Labeling requirements

Country-specific regulations

Work with internal and external regulatory resources to ensure compliance.

Packaging Development & Product Commercialization

Coordinate packaging design projects with suppliers and internal stakeholders.

Manage artwork revisions and approvals.

Ensure packaging complies with all applicable regulatory and customer requirements.

Coordinate packaging testing and validation.

Support new product launches from concept through commercialization.

Production Coordination

Collaborate closely with the Director of Supply Chain Operations.

Support production scheduling and manufacturing capacity planning.

Monitor factory production status.

Track manufacturing milestones and shipment readiness.

Escalate production risks proactively.

Help ensure products are delivered on schedule and in full.

Risk Management

Identify supply chain risks before they become disruptions.

Develop contingency sourcing strategies.

Maintain secondary supplier options where appropriate.

Monitor geopolitical, regulatory, tariff, and transportation risks.

Create mitigation plans for critical products.

Required Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain, Business, Engineering, International Trade, or related field.

5+ years of international sourcing experience.

Experience sourcing products from Asia and/or Latin America.

Proven negotiation experience with overseas factories.

Strong understanding of manufacturing processes.

Experience managing supplier relationships.

Experience with quality systems and supplier audits.

Strong financial and analytical skills.

Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.

Ability to travel internationally as required.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience in regulated industries such as medical devices, healthcare, pharmaceuticals, consumer products, or industrial manufacturing.

Knowledge of quality management systems and supplier compliance programs.

Experience with packaging development.

Experience with product commercialization and product launches.

Experience conducting overseas factory audits.

Fluency in Mandarin, Vietnamese, Thai, Spanish, Portuguese, or other relevant languages is a plus.

Critical Success Factors



The successful candidate will demonstrate:



Exceptional integrity and ethical conduct.

Strong critical-thinking and problem-solving abilities.

Data-driven decision-making.

Aggressive but professional negotiation skills.

Ability to challenge suppliers constructively.

Ability to identify cost-saving opportunities.

Strong attention to detail.

Ownership mentality and accountability.

Ability to operate independently with minimal supervision.

Fiduciary Duty, Ethics & Conflict of Interest Requirements



This position is held to the highest fiduciary and ethical standards.



The employee must always act solely in the best interests of the Company and its affiliated entities.



As a condition of employment:



The employee may not accept commissions, kickbacks, rebates, gifts, referral fees, overrides, consulting fees, or any other compensation from suppliers, manufacturers, brokers, trading companies, freight forwarders, consultants, or other third parties doing business with the Company.

The employee may not own, directly or indirectly, any financial interest in a supplier, manufacturer, broker, trading company, or service provider utilized by the Company without prior written disclosure and approval.

The employee may not participate in any purchasing, sourcing, supplier selection, or contract negotiation decision that presents an actual or perceived conflict of interest.

The employee must immediately disclose any actual, potential, or perceived conflict of interest.

The employee must comply with all Company procurement, ethics, anti-bribery, anti-corruption, confidentiality, and supplier conduct policies.

All supplier recommendations must be based solely on quality, compliance, service, reliability, risk profile, and total cost of ownership considerations.

Any violation of these requirements may result in immediate termination and may subject the employee to legal action where applicable.

Confidentiality & Intellectual Property



Due to the strategic nature of this role, the employee will have access to confidential supplier information, product designs, pricing, sourcing strategies, forecasts, customer information, and other proprietary business information.



As a condition of employment, the employee must:



Execute a Confidentiality, Non-Disclosure, and Intellectual Property Assignment Agreement.

Maintain strict confidentiality regarding all Company information.

Return all Company records and materials upon termination of employment.

Assign to the Company all work product, supplier relationships developed on behalf of the Company, sourcing strategies, databases, specifications, packaging designs, processes, and intellectual property created during employment.

Refrain from using Company information for personal gain or for the benefit of any third party.

Performance Metrics (KPIs)



Success in this role will be measured through:



Annual cost savings achieved

Supplier quality performance

On-time delivery performance

Supplier responsiveness

Regulatory compliance performance

Successful product launches

Supply continuity and risk reduction

Packaging project completion

Inventory availability support

Negotiated improvements in pricing and payment terms

Supplier diversification and contingency planning effectiveness



This position serves as a trusted steward of the Company's global supply chain and is expected to consistently act in the Company's best interests while maximizing value, minimizing risk, and maintaining the highest standards of professionalism and integrity.

description:
Job Title: Architect – Interior Design Documentation Specialist (Fully Remote)

Schedule: 9:00 AM – 5:30 PM PST, Monday–Friday (12:00 AM – 8:30 AM PH Time)

Company: Alignment Architects Inc., Cupertino, CA

Location: Fully Remote



Company Introduction

Join our fast-growing architectural and design firm based in San Jose, backed by AlphaX RE Capital. We specialize in single-family homes, ADUs, SB9 projects, multi-family dwellings, and light industrial developments. With a full range of real estate services—from land acquisition to project execution—Alignment Architects Inc. offers a dynamic environment for collaboration, technical growth, and design excellence.



Position Overview

We are seeking a detail-oriented and technically skilled Architect – Interior Design Documentation Specialist to support our residential projects in California. This role focuses on the preparation of high-quality interior design construction documents and post-permit revisions.



You will play a critical role in translating design intent into precise, buildable drawings, ensuring coordination across disciplines and compliance with applicable codes and standards. This position is ideal for someone with strong documentation experience who thrives in a fast-paced, production-driven environment.



Key Responsibilities

- Construction Documentation:

Develop and refine detailed interior design construction documents, including floor plans, reflected ceiling plans (RCPs), elevations, sections, schedules, and interior details.

- Technical Coordination:

Coordinate architectural interiors with structural, MEP (mechanical, electrical, plumbing), and civil drawings to ensure fully integrated and conflict-free documentation.

- Code Compliance:

Ensure all drawings comply with California building codes, local zoning regulations, and industry standards.

- Post-Permit Documentation:

Prepare supplemental drawings, revisions, and addendums to address plan check comments, RFIs, and construction changes.

- Design Translation:

Accurately translate design concepts, sketches, and markups from designers into clear and precise technical drawings.

- Team Collaboration:

Work closely with architects, interior designers, project managers, and consultants to maintain documentation accuracy and efficiency.

- Quality Control:

Review drawings for completeness, consistency, and constructability prior to submission.

- Software Utilization:

Produce high-quality drawings using industry-standard tools such as Revit, AutoCAD, and Bluebeam.



Qualifications

- Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s Degree in Architecture

- Experience: Minimum of 3 years in architectural/interior design documentation (residential experience preferred; US projects a plus)

- Software Proficiency:

- Strong proficiency in Revit & Autocad (required)

- Knowledge of SketchUp and Bluebeam is an advantage

- Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite

- Technical Knowledge:

- Strong understanding of construction detailing and documentation standards

- Familiarity with MEP and structural coordination

- Knowledge of California codes is a plus



- Skills:

- Excellent written and verbal English communication

- Strong attention to detail and organization

- Ability to manage multiple deadlines in a fast-paced environment

- Proactive, collaborative, and accountable work ethic



If interested, send a message with your updated CV and portfolio. Make sure your CV and portfolio are visible to us (or accessible). Thanks!
